title: Ran for you
old_caption:
Your date just ran off and left you in the snowy queue.
It came back with two hot cocoas.

title: Found yours
old_caption:
Dating someone who stares at the stars instead of you?
They were finding your stars. Castor and Pollux, the Twins.

title: Practised listening
old_caption:
Is your Leo rehearsing a speech in the mirror again?
The whole speech was one question, and then it listened.

title: The true part
old_caption:
Typing, deleting, typing again. Four screens long.
The best reply is usually the shortest true one.

title: In snow, holding hands
old_caption:
Why is Pisces lying in the snow, crying?
Two snow angels, holding hands. Happy tears count.

title: Saying “I’m fine” with my whole chest
old_caption:
Saying "I'm fine" while a tiny storm cloud follows you around?
You're allowed to not be fine. Tell one person the real answer.

title: Rereading my text after it delivered
old_caption:
Reading your own sent text for the fourth time like it might change?
It was kind. It was clear. Let it be sent.

title: Laughing at my own text before sending
old_caption:
Cracking up at your own text before you even hit send?
If it made you laugh, it's already a good text.

title: Planning our wedding after one good text
old_caption:
One nice text and the mood board is already up?
Enjoy the spark. Let the real person show you who they are first.

title: Saying “it’s chill” while not chill
old_caption:
Typing "it's chill :)" while your tea is shaking in the cup?
If it bothered you, a calm "actually, that stung a bit" is allowed.
